boundary.authority: the exact process-local applied outcome object returned by attended execution
boundary.durability: the same trusted host must read and revalidate the exact persisted terminal outcome before delivery
boundary.result: the exact frozen in-memory Design IR object retained from typed patch application
boundary.receipt: one content-addressed handoff receipt binds the terminal outcome and all result identities
boundary.serialization: serialized or reconstructed outcomes and host handles carry no handoff authority

checked: only the exact live applied-outcome object and its original trusted host can request handoff
the terminal record is read again and must exactly match its schema-valid content-addressed outcome
the retained Design IR is schema-valid and exactly matches the committed result identity
one immutable content-addressed receipt accompanies the exact frozen in-memory Design IR object
successful delivery is process-local and single use even under concurrent requests
notClaimed: persistent storage or restart recovery of the applied Design IR
transactional application source writes or rollback
a production receipt authenticator or multi-host durable store
public CLI or MCP screenshot repair activation
